svg.title: 清代朝袍｜斜向分层解构矢量插画
svg.desc: Standalone oblique exploded conceptual Qing emperor court robe. Separate editable groups: collar, upper robe, cuffs, waist panel, pleated panel and lower skirt. Ornament is interpretive, not an exact artifact reconstruction. Transparent background. No text or raster imagery.
